# Lucid

> Lucid is an AI-powered accounting firm for medical practices. It combines automated bookkeeping with a dedicated CPA and CFO support, and handles taxes and tax credits.

Lucid serves medical, dental and allied-health practices in the US, from solo practices to multi-location groups. Services: bookkeeping, tax preparation and planning, CFO services, cash flow reporting and forecasting, and tax credits. Lucid does not provide clinical billing or insurance claims submission.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.lucid.now/): overview of services and how Lucid works
- [Pricing](https://www.lucid.now/pricing): transparent pricing, month-to-month
- [Platforms](https://www.lucid.now/platforms): cash flow reporting, categorization, reconciliation
- [Security](https://www.lucid.now/security): data security and HIPAA-aligned controls
- [Blog](https://www.lucid.now/blog): guides for practice owners on finance and tax
